## What problem does this solve?

A clear description of the problem or limitation you're running into.
e.g. "I can't easily do X, which means I have to..."

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see added or changed.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you've thought about, and why they're not ideal.

## Additional context

Screenshots, examples from other tools, or anything else that would help explain the idea.
